Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the relevant city as Rome instead of Vatican City (where Pope Pius XI, author of Quadragesimo Anno, died). This misinterpretation would lead the search toward “Governor of Rome” rather than “Governor of Vatican City,” causing an incorrect end year. The correct office is Governor of Vatican City, which ended in 1952.
